executiveSummary.headline: Reconcile Hilton Amenities With Four 0% Recognition Gaps
executiveSummary.lead: The hotel ranks #2 of 6 in its certified Hilton Honors set but appears in only 10.4% of comparable answers and 28.3% of eligible scenarios. The immediate task is to reconcile explicit first-party facts with the staged reality gaps, while treating technical-probe results as bounded observations rather than causal proof.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared. Peer position is certified-set context. These measures do not represent bookings, ADR, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Reconcile Hilton Amenities With Four 0% Recognition Gaps
themes.what: Hilton's official hotel-information page lists on-site restaurant, room service, Digital Key, and Connecting Rooms; the certified reality-gap read recorded 0% recognition for all four.
themes.whyItMatters: These facts affect family, dining, and convenience decisions, but the gap does not prove that official-page content caused low consideration.

themes.title: Build a Source-Backed Celebrations and Events Entry Path
themes.what: Celebrations & Events was the softest monitored territory at 0% scenario capture. Hilton's official hotel-information page lists meeting rooms, but the available evidence does not establish a complete celebration proposition.
themes.whyItMatters: The hotel should confirm actual event inventory and target occasions before publishing expanded positioning.

themes.title: Strengthen City-View and Walkable-Location Decision Context
themes.what: The certified read recorded 0% for City Views and Walkable Downtown while the property identity is Hilton New York Times Square at 234 West 42nd Street.
themes.whyItMatters: Location identity and view claims are material, but exact view categories and walking-distance language require hotel-approved facts.

actionsResearchRecord.headline: Reconcile Hilton Amenities With Four 0% Recognition Gaps
actionsResearchRecord.priorityWhy: Hilton's official hotel-information page lists on-site restaurant, room service, Digital Key, and Connecting Rooms; the certified reality-gap read recorded 0% recognition for all four.
actionsResearchRecord.whatWeFound: Hilton's official hotel-information page lists on-site restaurant, room service, Digital Key, and Connecting Rooms; the certified reality-gap read recorded 0% recognition for all four.
actionsResearchRecord.whyItMatters: These facts affect family, dining, and convenience decisions, but the gap does not prove that official-page content caused low consideration.
recommendedSteps: Operations confirms current availability and restrictions for each amenity.
Align overview, hotel-info, rooms, dining, and structured amenity fields.
Verify confirmed-connecting-room and room-service wording is precise.
Archive live evidence for the next governed measurement.
